script.title: Logged in as admin without a password?

dialogue.speaker: budhdev
dialogue.text: My PHP login works, but my friend got in as admin without the password. He just typed a quote and some dashes in the username box. How?

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: Your query glues the username straight into the SQL text. His quote closed your string, and everything after it became SQL.

dialogue.speaker: budhdev
dialogue.text: So if he types admin, a quote, then two dashes, what does the database actually run?

pause.prompt: The username is admin'-- . What happens to the password check?
choices: It turns into a comment and is skipped

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: Two dashes start a comment, so the password check simply disappears. The query finds admin and logs him in.

dialogue.speaker: budhdev
dialogue.text: Should I just strip quotes out of the input, then?

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: No. Use a prepared statement. The query and the values travel separately, so input can never turn into code.

script.takeaway: Never build SQL by pasting input into the query text; use prepared statements so input stays data.
